3. TRAVEL AND LEAVE COMBINATIONS 3.1 Employees may combine approved business travel with personal leave where operational requirements permit.
3.2 When business travel is combined with personal leave, the company will pay only the expenses directly attributable to the approved business portion.
reference_answer: The travel expense policy allows for the combination of approved business travel with personal leave where operational requirements permit. Employees must obtain written approval from their Line Manager and HR before combining business travel with annual leave. Additionally, the company will pay only the expenses directly attributable to the approved business portion, while additional personal accommodation, meals, transport, and travel changes must be paid by the employee.
